description: Form 8959 line 8 is Schedule SE line 6, which stays blank when net earnings (line 4c) are under $400 — such earnings are not 'self-employment income' (§ 1402(b)). Single 2025: wages $250,000 → Part I 0.9% × $50,000 = $450; Schedule C profit $400 → net earnings $369.40 < $400 → Part II $0. Additional Medicare Tax $450 (counting the $369.40 gave $453).
